case_title: Operation Chakra - Jamtara Cyber Syndicate & Hawala Network
police_station: Cyber Crime Special Cell, Mandir Marg, New Delhi
crime_type: Organized Cyber Financial Fraud & Money Laundering
master_plot: A highly coordinated cyber syndicate operating across Jamtara, Deoghar (Jharkhand) and Delhi NCR utilizing 64-port SIM boxes, rogue banking APK malware, forged Aadhaar KYC mule accounts, and layered UPI-to-Hawala channels to siphon over ₹3.4 Crores from senior citizens and PSU executives within minutes of credential compromise.

modus_operandi.summary: Victims are targeted via spoofed SMS alerts warning of imminent electricity disconnection or bank KYC expiry. Upon calling back, victims are coerced into installing 'QuickSupport' or rogue '.apk' payloads. OTPs are intercepted in real-time. Siphoned funds are instantaneously distributed into 14 mule accounts within 180 seconds, followed by ATM cash withdrawals and cash handovers to Hawala couriers in Chandni Chowk.
modus_operandi.syndicate_hierarchy: Tier 1: Mastermind / Tech Operator -> Tier 2: SIM Box & Spoofing Operators -> Tier 3: Mule Account Managers -> Tier 4: ATM Runners & Hawala Couriers
modus_operandi.target_demographics: Retired Central Govt / PSU Employees, Senior Citizens across Delhi NCR, Pune, Bengaluru
modus_operandi.digital_footprint: Virtual Private Servers hosted in offshore nodes, encrypted Telegram bots for OTP exfiltration, 32-port GSM VoIP gateways

case_title: Operation Garuda - Inter-State Highway Dacoity & Arms Racket
police_station: Special Staff South-West, Delhi Police & STF Haryana
crime_type: Armed Highway Dacoity & Illegal Firearms Supply
master_plot: An inter-state armed gang intercepted a cash-in-transit transit vehicle on NH-48 near Kherki Daula toll, firing 8 rounds, looting ₹1.2 Crore in bullion and currency. The gang procures 9mm countrymade clone pistols from Munger, Bihar and operates safehouses across Sonipat and Alwar.

modus_operandi.summary: Gang conducts 10-day physical recce using modified pickup campers with fake number plates. GPS jammers are activated 2 km prior to target ambush. Shooters fire at tires and driver cabin, loot bags within 90 seconds, and transfer contraband to escort SUVs stationed on bypass link roads.

modus_operandi.target_demographics: Jewellery Bullion Couriers, Non-Banking Cash Logistics Vans, Highway Petrol Station Managers
modus_operandi.digital_footprint: Single-use keypad phones disposed of after each robbery, Signal messenger on spoofed burner tablets

case_title: Operation Trishul - Western Coastal Narcotics Transshipment
police_station: Anti-Narcotics Cell (ANC), Mumbai & Indian Coast Guard
master_plot: A transnational maritime cartel intercepted off the coast of Porbandar and Vasai transshipping 120 kg of high-purity methamphetamine concealed in cold-storage fishing trawlers. Financed through hawala networks between Dubai, Mumbai, and Surat.

modus_operandi.summary: Deep-sea rendezvous at 40 nautical miles off Gujarat coast using satellite communication codes. Contraband transferred to local fishing vessels under cover of fish consignments, landed at secluded creeks in Vasai and Raigad, then ferried via refrigerated trucks to inland distribution hubs.
modus_operandi.syndicate_hierarchy: Offshore Coordinator (Farooq) -> Landing Chief (Aslam) -> Logistics / Transport (Anna) -> Hawala Controller (Junaid)
modus_operandi.target_demographics: Nightclub syndicates, rave circuits, and youth distribution networks across Mumbai, Goa, Bengaluru
modus_operandi.digital_footprint: Thuraya satellite phones, GPS waypoint coordinate exchanges, crypto tether accounts
modus_operandi.geographic_spread: Porbandar, Vasai Creek, Crawford Market (Mumbai), Dubai
